analysis.title: Shopify 3Q26 First Take; In-line quarter not enough
key_insights: Shopify posted a broadly in-line 3Q26. Revenue and GMV were near Street with a slight beat on operating income. DB says the lack of upside will be read as disappointing because outperformance has been the norm and because agentic commerce may add only a very modest benefit.
GMV was $119.1bn, up about 29.5% y/y reported and below Street 30.5% and DBe 30%. Y/Y growth slowed about 1pt from 2Q on a constant-currency basis despite a 1 point tougher comparison.
Underlying GMV growth in Europe and North America was stable with last quarter at 30% and 28% y/y respectively. DB reads this as momentum on key initiatives remaining intact.

Subscription revenue of $836mn (+20% y/y) was below Street $850mn (+22% y/y) despite an in-line MRR of $230mn. DB says this could indicate slower platform fee growth (i.e. Shopify Plus GMV) than consensus expected.
Gross profit grew 28% y/y, in line with Street and DB, against guidance for mid-to-high-twenties growth. Better merchant solutions gross margin offset worse subscription solutions gross margin.

Subscription cost of revenue rose to $175mn (GAAP), up $12mn q/q and $47mn y/y. It included a $40mn y/y increase in infrastructure costs (cloud hosting, infrastructure software, LLM usage) versus a $37mn increase in 2Q. DB attributes this to higher platform usage and rising AI-related costs.
OpEx was 32.4% of revenue, below the 33-34% guide. This drove modest upside to operating profit and FCF. Non-GAAP operating profit was $715mn at a 19.1% margin versus Street $678mn at 18.1%.

4Q guidance: revenue is guided to grow in the low-30s% y/y (DB estimates about 32% at the midpoint) versus Street 30%. Gross profit is guided to grow at a high-20s% rate versus Street +28%. DB says this suggests stable growth despite growing scale.
4Q OpEx is guided to 29-30% of revenue, above Street on a percentage basis. Non-GAAP operating profit is implied at about $892mn (~18.4% margin), below Street $999mn.
4Q FCF margin is guided to be consistent with 4Q25 at 21%, which implies about $1,018mn, ahead of Street $984mn.

DB expects four main questions on the call: GMV trajectory and sources of strength or weakness, early signs of agentic commerce and its effect on GMV and the financial model, the level of incremental 4Q investment, and the impact of Sidekick and monetizing its AI capabilities.
DB keeps a Buy rating and a $185 price target. The stock closed at $156.22 on 2 Nov 2026.

market_movers.rationale: DB keeps Buy and a $185 target after an in-line 3Q26. About 30% GMV and revenue growth is intact and 4Q revenue guidance is above Street, but operating profit guidance is below Street.

earnings_insights: Shopify 3Q26 (reported 11/3 first take): GMV $119.1bn, about 29.5% y/y reported, versus Street 30.5% and DBe 30% (reported estimates).
Shopify 3Q26 reported: ending MRR $230mn versus Street $230mn and DBe $228mn.
Shopify 3Q26 reported: subscription revenue $836mn (+20% y/y) versus Street $850mn (+22% y/y) and DBe $838mn (+20% y/y).
Shopify 3Q26 reported: merchant solutions revenue $2.91bn versus Street $2.90bn and DBe $2.91bn. Take rate was 2.44% versus Street 2.41% and DBe 2.43%.
Shopify 3Q26 reported: GAAP gross profit +28% y/y with gross margin 47.6%, versus Street and DB at about 47.6%.
Shopify 3Q26 reported: non-GAAP operating profit $715mn at a 19.1% margin versus Street $678mn at 18.1%. OpEx was 32.4% of revenue versus a 33-34% guide.
Shopify 4Q26 guidance (company guide, DB read): revenue low-30s% y/y versus Street/DB +30% y/y. Gross profit high-20s% y/y versus Street/DB +28% y/y.
Shopify 4Q26 guidance: GAAP OpEx 29-30% of revenue versus DB 27% and Street 28%. Implied non-GAAP operating profit is about $892mn (~18.4% margin) versus Street estimate $999mn.
Shopify 4Q26 guidance: FCF margin consistent with 4Q25 at 21%, implying about $1,018mn versus Street estimate $984mn.
risk_factors: The lack of upside versus a run of beats may disappoint investors.
Agentic commerce may deliver only a very modest benefit to GMV.
DB flags possible headwinds to hear about on the call: other geographies, de minimis, and the overall scale of the business.
Subscription revenue below expectations may signal slower platform fee growth (Shopify Plus GMV).
Rising infrastructure and LLM usage costs are pressuring subscription solutions gross margin.
4Q implied operating profit is below Street because of higher incremental OpEx investment.

tension_points.bull_case: About 30% GMV and revenue growth is impressive. 4Q revenue is guided low-30s% versus Street 30%, GMV growth in Europe and North America is stable, and DB says momentum on key initiatives remains intact.
tension_points.bear_case: The quarter was only in line when outperformance has been the norm. Subscription revenue missed Street, GMV was below Street, agentic commerce may add little, and 4Q implied operating profit of $892mn is below Street $999mn.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Headwinds disclosed on the earnings call (other geographies, de minimis, overall scale of the business) or weaker GMV trajectory commentary.

theme_stances.key_argument: Revenue and gross profit guidance suggest stable growth is achievable despite growing scale.
theme_stances.evidence: This continues to suggest stable growth is achievable despite growing scale.
